title: Rosy Haven
description: A soft and aesthetic background pack that transforms Minecraft’s main menu into a calm, rosy haven with a cozy and refreshing vibe.
body:
Rosy Haven is a beautifully designed background pack that enhances Minecraft’s main menu with a soft, pink-toned aesthetic inspired by peaceful and cozy environments. The pack introduces a calm and visually pleasing atmosphere, making every game launch feel more relaxing and inviting.

With its clean composition and gentle color palette, Rosy Haven maintains the original Minecraft style while adding a subtle yet elegant visual upgrade. The design focuses on simplicity and balance, ensuring that the background remains immersive without being overwhelming.

Perfect for players who enjoy aesthetic visuals and a serene ambiance, Rosy Haven delivers a polished and refreshing experience, giving the game’s opening screen a unique and professional touch. 🌸✨
